title: EventPayload
description: Payload representing a stored PCR/Nows document event with defendant and case details.

eventType.description: Type of the event, e.g., PRISON_COURT_REGISTER_GENERATED

eventId.description: Unique identifier of the stored PCR/Nows document event

hearingId.description: Unique identifier of the hearing associated with this event

materialId.description: Unique identifier of the stored PCR/Nows document

masterDefendantId.description: Unique identifier for the master defendant

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth of the defendant

cases.description: List of cases associated with the defendant

urn.description: Case URN associated with the defendant

payload.description: Full structured document payload, when provided.
